Messages.Author: Patrick van der Reest
Messages.Body:
Imperial Degree is an action that can be taken by a Justicar or Inner Circle
member. Once in play, it allows all Camarilla vampires to attack
Non-Camarilla vampires as a (D) action. I'm pretty sure the answer is
somewhere out there, but does this include Sabbat vampires?
Linguistically, they are non-Camarilla, but when this card was printed (and
card text has not been changed since, afaik) there was no Sabbat in VTES
yet. The independant kindred were called Non-Camarilla, and when Sabbat came
out, their Kindred were denominated Sabbat. This leaves it open, whether
Sabbat vampires are Non-Camarilla as well.

Thanks for your help and my blessings,

Patrick
